data.description:
Filed at AS-131 review per that plan's Decision 4 (the incremental-DOM half of the board's lazy-load request, split out so each task carries one risk).

WHAT
Stop rebuilding the whole main pane on every live frame in apps/chat. Today renderConversation() (public/app.js) does pane.replaceChildren(...data.messages.map(messageNode)) on EVERY re-render — every SSE push frame (AS-25), every send echo, every since= catch-up merge, every older-page prepend — not just on open. Replace it with an incremental update: append/insert only the node(s) for the message(s) that changed, update the affected root's reply count in place, and keep the anchor/highlight, thread-modal and sticky-bottom paths (AS-9, AS-17, AS-26) working.

WHY
AS-131 bounds the rebuild to the loaded set (50 top-level messages by default, more after scroll-up), which removes the symptom the board reported. The remaining cost is proportional to what is loaded: a reader who has paged back through #lattice-events (681 roots today, growing every tick) or the board DM again re-parses and re-renders every loaded row on each frame. Behaviour of shipped code, performance; not a correctness defect — priority medium.

SHAPE (decision context for the planner, not the decision)
- Keep renderConversation for navigation (open / conversation switch); add an applyFrame-style path for single-message merges that inserts one messageNode in id order and patches replyCount text.
- Falsifiers to name: a frame must add exactly one node (count before/after); a reply frame must patch only its root's count; the sticky-bottom rule and the m= anchor must survive an incremental insert; an older-page prepend (AS-131 loadOlderPage) must still hold the reader's row.
- Touches messageNode/applyAnchor/renderThread/highlight paths — its own review.

complexity: medium
data.title: Chat: incremental message DOM — stop rebuilding the pane on live frames

data.note: Split from AS-131 (plan Decision 4): pagination bounds the rebuild; incremental DOM removes it

data.body: Triage note from the AS-131 merge (cto-owen): Priya's cycle-2 residual R5 folds here — live.js mergeOlderPage installs the server's thread list for a fresh root and can overwrite an orphan reply list a live frame stored during the one-round-trip window between the server building the page and the client merging it; the reply is invisible until the next since= catch-up re-delivers it. Not a behaviour defect under criterion 8 (replace is pinned), so nothing filed; a union with the orphan list for fresh roots closes it. Demo: scratchpad/agent-qa-priya/AS-131/cycle-2/probe-merge-race.log. R1–R4 stay on AS-131's record.

Plan at .lattice/plans/task_01M2BEEDK4E81C5TJQ4XJS6YFZ.md (107 lines, commit 9b99522). Decisions: (1) the incremental logic lives in a new module public/message-pane.js in the scroll.js pattern — it takes the panes and node factories as arguments and touches only id/classList/children/insertBefore/appendChild/removeChild/textContent plus the three scroll metrics, so a plain-object fake element makes every falsifier a host test, no jsdom; app.js keeps factories and wiring only. (2) Mirror invariant: main pane .message children == data.messages in id order, thread pane == [root, ...replies]; rebuilt on navigation and prepend, patched on frames; criterion 7 asserts incremental == fresh render. (3) Sticky-bottom is composed: each insert runs inside renderPreservingScroll; a catch-up delta is N measured inserts. (4) DOM-level idempotence and ordered insert walking from the last child (append is one comparison). (5) One label source replyLabel(count) shared by messageNode and the in-place patch; no count-0 branch (replyCount never decreases). (6) Pure exported routing frameTargets(data, msg, currentThreadRoot). (7) applyAnchor still runs; the anchored node is no longer recreated, so the highlight survives a frame. (8) R5 from Priya's AS-131 cycle-2 folded in: mergeOlderPage unions an orphan list into a fresh root's server list, replyCount = merged length — additive to the existing criterion-8 test. Out of scope: loadOlderPage keeps its rebuild under prependPreservingScroll (user-initiated, once per page); server/store/CLI/export untouched. 13 criteria, mutants M1–M9 plus M5b/M6b with exact expected red sets; AS-131 M9 re-run pins the prepend. Staffing: developer-lena implements (wrote the AS-131 seam this same day); qa-ruben reviews (Priya reviewed AS-131 twice and R5 is her own residual; the risk here is a merge seam, his lane). Predicted: +11 host tests over master 663/660/0/3 → 674/671/0/3; compose 674/665/0/9 with the Image asc-impl-as135-test Built receipt via bin/compose-run.mjs. Branch feat/AS-135-incremental-dom, worktree .worktrees/AS-135. Notes: scratchpad/agent-cto-owen/AS-135/notes.md.

Implementation complete on feat/AS-135-incremental-dom (fast-forwarded onto 86f1529): df1ebaa, d126e26, fc0d3d1, bb0f43a.

Built: new pure module public/message-pane.js (messageIdOf, replyLabel, insertMessageNode, setReplyCount, frameTargets, applyFrameToPanes; only id/classList/children/insertBefore/appendChild/removeChild/textContent + scroll metrics touched; each insert composed under renderPreservingScroll). app.js: threadLinkNode extracted from messageNode (replyLabel is the one label source), renderFrame(msg) = applyFrameToPanes + applyAnchor; handleFrame, sendMessage and catchUp (per merged row) call it; renderConversation keeps selectConversation as its single caller; loadOlderPage/prepend and navigation unchanged. live.js: R5 union in mergeOlderPage for a fresh root with orphan replies, replyCount = merged length; loaded roots unchanged. README: rendering rule line. Tests: test/message-pane.test.js T1-T10 (plain-object fake element, source pins on app.js), one additive live test.

Deviation, boring and necessary: server.js STATIC_FILES gained /message-pane.js (else the browser 404s the import) and the AS-74 served-module pin moved 14 -> 15 as that test demands (bb0f43a). The first full host run and first compose run were red on exactly that pin.

Counts: host baseline 663/660/0/3 -> 674/671/0/3 (+11, as predicted). Compose: `Image asc-impl-as135-test Built`, 674/665/0/9, leak check clean, project asc-impl-as135.

Mutants: 13 run (M1-M9, M5b, M6b, plus M7b thread-side and the AS-131 M9 prepend re-run), all red, every site asserted in a detached scratch worktree, scratch diff clean after. M9-prepend red set exactly {prependPreservingScroll x2}. Three sets wider than the plan predicted (M5 +T9, M5b +T7/T9, M6 +T7) — same defect seen by more observers, none narrower. Table: scratchpad/agent-developer-lena/AS-135/mutant-table.md; logs alongside.

Left undone: the interactive browser check (plan step 4 — scroll-up + frame, thread reply, permalink + frame) was not done; a worktree-server module-graph smoke on port 8399 passed (app.js's 12 imports and message-pane.js -> scroll.js all served; smoke.mjs). Q1 default taken (no empty-note handling on the thread pane); Q2 not triggered.
